title: Approval Note — Heat Exchanger E-201
body:
Equipment
E-201; report reference: IR-E201-2026-08-20

Findings
Rows 12–15 measured 3.8–4.2 mm against the minimum allowable 4.6 mm. Localised pitting corrosion at the shell inlet nozzle has a maximum depth of 1.8 mm. The channel-head gasket shows degradation and replacement is recommended before return to service.

Recommendation
Conditional clearance pending retubing of the affected tubes. The recommended gasket replacement must be recorded before return to service. [SOP-114 §3.2]

Grounding references
[SOP-114 §3.2]

citations.label: SOP-114 §3.2
citations.supportingExcerpt: When a report identifies a tube-wall measurement below the minimum allowable value, localised pitting, or gasket degradation, the approval note must list each finding and its evidence. Conditional clearance may be recorded only when the affected tubes are scheduled for retubing and any recommended gasket replacement is recorded. The approval note must cite this section as [SOP-114 §3.2].
